name: National Bank of Kuwait
founded: 1952 (incorporated in the State of Kuwait; first national bank in Kuwait and the Gulf)
ownership_summary: Listed on Boursa Kuwait (previously Kuwait Stock Exchange) since 1984; widely held, retaining its founding merchant shareholder base. The only shareholder above 5% is the Public Institution for Social Security (PIFSS) with 6.19% at 31 Dec 2025 and at 30 Jun 2026. Market capitalisation KD 7.40bn at 30 Jun 2026.
government_link: Minority only - PIFSS (Kuwait's state social-security institution) holds 6.19% (30 Jun 2026); no controlling shareholder.
group_structure: National Bank of Kuwait S.A.K.P. is the listed parent. Principal subsidiaries (31 Dec 2025): Boubyan Bank K.S.C.P. (60.4%, Islamic bank, listed; profiled separately as kw-boubyan - fully consolidated, so its assets, deposits and profit are already inside NBK group figures; do not add them), which holds BLME Holdings (72.4%, UK, incl. Nomo); National Bank of Kuwait - Egypt (99.1%); Watani Investment Company K.S.C.(Closed) (100%, investment company; absorbed Watani Financial Brokerage in 2025); National Bank of Kuwait (International) PLC (UK, 100%); National Bank of Kuwait France SA (100%); NBK Banque Privee (Suisse) S.A. (100%, investment management); National Bank of Kuwait (Lebanon) (85.5%); Credit Bank of Iraq (92.5%); National Investors Group Holdings (Cayman, 100%); Watani Wealth Management Company (KSA, 100%); NBK GDM (Caymans) (100%); UPayments (Kuwait fintech, 51%). Six reportable segments: Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, NBK Wealth, Islamic Banking (= Boubyan), Group Centre, International Banking.

footprint: 13 countries on 4 continents (FY2025): Kuwait 70 branches; Egypt 53; Bahrain 2; UAE 3 (incl. DIFC branch opened 2025); KSA 3; Lebanon 2; Iraq 3; one branch each in London, Paris, New York, Shanghai and Singapore. FY2025 net operating income: Kuwait KD 923.2m, other MENA KD 221.8m, Europe & UK KD 86.7m, others KD 65.1m.
customer_segments: Mass retail and youth (incl. Weyay digital bank), affluent (Premium Services; Premium, Thahabi and Elite segments), HNW/UHNW and institutional (NBK Wealth), SME, large and mid-market corporates, foreign corporates/oil and trade finance, international clients; Islamic customers via Boubyan.
business_lines: Consumer & Digital Banking (deposits, cards, lending, Weyay digital bank, premium segments); Corporate & Transactional Banking; NBK Wealth (private banking, asset management, custody, brokerage via Watani Investment Company, NBK Banque Privee (Suisse), Watani Wealth Management KSA); Islamic Banking (Boubyan Bank); Group Treasury (FX, hedging, structured deposits); International Banking Group (12 countries).

capabilities.wealth_summary: NBK runs wealth through NBK Wealth, formed by merging its private banking and asset management under one leadership (CEO Faisal Al-Hamad), serving HNWI/SHNWI/UHNWI and institutional clients from booking centres in Kuwait, KSA, UAE (DIFC), Switzerland (NBK Banque Privee (Suisse)), the UK and Ireland. Group AUM was KD 8,693m at 31 Dec 2025 (+13.6%), and the NBK Wealth segment earned KD 125.8m net operating income in FY2025. Asset management, funds and brokerage sit in Watani Investment Company (100%), which in Feb 2025 launched the NBK Invest app (guided multi-asset plans from USD 5,000, conventional and Shariah options, plus 7 in-house funds) and renamed Watani Brokerage to NBK Brokerage (Regional, Sharia and US platforms). In 2025 NBK Wealth added alternative DPM, two value-add funds, a PE secondaries fund and NBK Wealth KSA's first Saudi real estate fund; 2026 priorities include NBK Suisse for UHNW clients and 'unlocking opportunities among the affluent'. Islamic retail wealth is largely in 60.4%-owned Boubyan Bank (profiled separately as kw-boubyan).

private_banking.detail: NBK Wealth Private Banking (CEO Global Private Banking & Switzerland: Malek Khalife). Services: wealth planning, family affairs, cash and credit management, fiduciaries' trusts and wills, offshore trusts, real estate, overseas services, dedicated private banker, treasury services, cards, concierge and 'Generation W' next-gen programme; booking centres in Kuwait, KSA, UAE (DIFC), Switzerland, UK and Ireland. 2026 priority: 'Availing NBK Suisse for ultra-high networth clients'.

asset_management.detail: Watani Investment Company K.S.C.(Closed) (100%; merged with Watani Financial Brokerage in 2025), Watani Wealth Management (KSA, 100%), NBK Wealth Investment Management Limited and NBK Banque Privee (Suisse) S.A. (investment management, 100%). Group AUM KD 8,693m at 31 Dec 2025. Public funds: Watani Kuwait Equity, Watani Gulf Equity, Watani USD Bond, Al-Watani Saudi Equity, Al-Watani Sukuk, Watani KD/USD Money Market and Watani Islamic KD/USD Money Market funds; separately managed accounts.

brokerage.detail: NBK Brokerage (brand of Watani Investment Company; renamed from Watani Brokerage Feb 2025): Regional (Boursa Kuwait and regional markets), Sharia, and US platforms (equities, options, ETFs, bonds on US exchanges plus global/emerging-market equities, ADRs/GDRs; margin or cash account; mobile app, online platform, phone). PRIME Brokerage also listed.

digital_investing.detail: NBK Invest app (launched Feb 2025 by Watani Investment Company): fully digital onboarding; Guided Investments (globally diversified multi-asset plans, 5,000+ companies, conventional or Shariah, min USD 5,000, top-ups from USD 100, daily liquidity); in-app money market, equity and bond funds. Requires Kuwait Civil ID and local bank account. NBK Brokerage apps for self-directed trading. Weyay digital bank (launched 2021) is a banking app; no investing feature found.

advisory.detail: NBK Wealth client-specific wealth, portfolio investment and real estate planning advisory using multi-asset strategies; 'Structured Investments & Advisory'; digital advice via NBK Invest Guided Investments.

discretionary.detail: Discretionary management listed under NBK Wealth investment management; 2025: structuring mandates and introducing/expanding Alternative Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM); multi-asset outcome-based solutions for UHNW.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: NBK Invest Guided Investments: risk-questionnaire-based, passive multi-asset plans (conventional and Shariah). The former SmartWealth URL now shows NBK Invest content.

funds_platform.detail: NBK Wealth states access to investment vehicles 'developed in-house or through partnerships with renowned global providers'; no third-party fund platform or provider named. NBK Invest offers only Watani funds (7 at launch).

structured_products.detail: 'Structured Investments & Advisory' under NBK Wealth alternative investments; Group Treasury offers structured deposits to HNW clients (2026 priority: expand to HNW clients outside Kuwait).

private_markets.detail: NBK Wealth Alternative Investments; in 2025 introduced two value-add funds and a private equity secondaries fund (single-call structure) and NBK Wealth (KSA)'s first Saudi-based real estate fund.

islamic_wealth.detail: NBK Brokerage - Sharia platform; Al-Watani Sukuk Fund; Watani Islamic KD and USD money market funds; Shariah-compliant NBK Invest guided plans. Group Islamic banking is in Boubyan Bank (see kw-boubyan).

partners.what: Partner for NBK Ebtakir, NBK's bank-led intrapreneurship programme
Microsoft Copilot rolled out across all NBK divisions
NBK Wealth site links a login at watanibrokerage.netxinvestor.com; NetXInvestor is a BNY Pershing client-portal brand. Inference from the URL only - NBK does not name the provider.

initiatives.what: Watani Investment Company launched NBK Invest (digital advisory + 7 Watani funds, fully digital onboarding) and renamed Watani Brokerage as NBK Brokerage (Regional, US, Sharia).
Merged Watani Financial Brokerage Company into Watani Investment Company (business combination under common control).
NBK Wealth introduced Alternative DPM, two value-add funds, a PE secondaries fund and NBK Wealth (KSA)'s first Saudi-based real estate fund.
Opened a DIFC branch in the UAE (International Banking Group).

NBK Wealth strategic priorities for 2026: diversify client portfolios, avail NBK Suisse for UHNW clients, family wealth transfer, regional institutions, 'unlocking opportunities among the affluent', expand regional presence.
NBK promoted Premium, Thahabi and Elite segments with access to NBK Wealth and NBK Invest and dedicated RMs.
2Q 2026 earnings call: management said the wealth management division and Boubyan continued to drive Group diversification, alongside continued investment in digital channels and mobile offerings.

opportunities: NBK Wealth's 2026 priorities include 'Unlocking opportunities among the affluent' and expanding regional presence (S3 p.46).

Product shelf described as in-house 'or through partnerships with renowned global providers' with no third-party platform named (S4 p.11); NBK Invest launched with only seven in-house Watani funds plus passive guided plans (S14, S11).
Premium/Thahabi/Elite affluent segments are being steered to NBK Wealth and NBK Invest (S15), but no affluent-specific discretionary or alternatives offer was found.
barriers: Large in-house manufacturing: Group AUM KD 8.7bn (S3) and own fund range, DPM, alternatives and private-markets funds.
Already runs proprietary digital channels (NBK Invest guided plans, NBK Brokerage apps) launched Feb 2025 (S14).
Islamic retail wealth sits in 60.4%-owned Boubyan, which uses Allfunds Nextportfolio for Nomo Investments (see kw-boubyan).
incumbent_vendors: NetXInvestor (BNY Pershing) - inferred from brokerage login URL watanibrokerage.netxinvestor.com on nbkwealth.com (S9); not confirmed by NBK.
